Is It Time to Replace Your Heating System?

On average, the life expectancy of a typical furnace is around 15 to 20 years. However, that doesn't necessarily mean you should go two decades between equipment upgrades. Many older systems use less efficient technologies than those available today, making them more costly to operate. As furnaces age, they may also begin producing less heat and experiencing more mechanical problems. So, when should you start shopping for a new system? While there's no single correct answer, it may be time for replacement if:

• Your furnace is out of warranty and past its expected lifespan
  • Your equipment keeps requiring more frequent or expensive furnace repairs
  • Your monthly utility bills are consistently running too high

The Perks of Professional Furnace Installation

We measure and analyze dozens of variables to precisely calculate your home's heating load under various conditions. This ensures the system we build for you will be perfectly designed to match your comfort demands without wasting energy. The result? More consistent and uniform heating, better reliability, lower utility bills, and greater value for your money.

Invest in Optimal Home Heating Performance

Considering climate control accounts for over 40% of the average household's energy consumption, more efficient HVAC equipment is a great investment. With G.C. Reliable Service, it's also one you can afford to make on nearly any budget. As an authorized Daikin and Lennox dealer, we've got high-quality heating systems and accessories at a range of price points.

What's more, we provide free consultations and clear, straightforward estimates for all our installations, so you know exactly what to expect. To help you maximize the return on your new investment, we also offer preventive furnace maintenance, inspection, and diagnostic testing services. With our annual heating tune-ups, you can keep your system performing at maximum capacity for years to come.

If you've been relying on an old and outdated furnace, there's a better way to heat your home. Learn more today by calling the heating installation and HVAC maintenance experts at G.C. Reliable Service.

metadata.lead_paragraph: We specialize in all high efficiency boilers, and are highly recommended by Laars, Lochinvar, Navien, etc. Unlike furnaces and heat pumps, boilers don’t use an air handler and ductwork to distribute heated air throughout your home. Instead, boilers heat water and distribute either hot water or steam through a network of pipes, utilizing radiators or radiant flooring systems to release the heat. At GC Reliable Service, we provide comprehensive boiler services throughout New Rochelle, White Plains, Harrison, Bronxville, Eastchester, Scarsdale, Pelham, Rye Brook, Irvington, Mamaroneck, Valhalla, Hartsdale, Larchmont, NY, and the surrounding areas.
